# staticform_notification_preferences (Resource)

The signed-in user's notification preferences: the global email switches and the per-event in-app and email choices. This is a singleton: one per user. Only the events listed in `events` are managed; every other event keeps the choice it has on the server, and global attributes you omit keep their current server value. `quiet_hours` is the exception: omitting it means no quiet hours. Destroying the resource only removes it from state; the preferences stay as they are on the server. Requires the `User.Notifications.GetPreferences` and `User.Notifications.UpdatePreferences` permissions.

Event keys come from the notification catalog. The three events that used to be separate account settings are `product.SubmitActionFailed` (formerly `submit_action_failure_notification_enabled`), `product.EmailQuotaWarning` (formerly `email_quota_warning_enabled`) and `product.StorageWarning` (formerly `storage_warning_enabled`). The other keys are `product.SubmissionReceived`, `product.DataExported`, `product.OverrideSubscriptionExpiringSoon`, `product.EmailDomainVerificationFailed` and `system.test`. The `staticform_notification_preferences` data source lists the catalog the API currently serves.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "staticform_notification_preferences" "me" {
  email_mode        = "DailyDigest"
  digest_hour_local = 8
  time_zone_id      = "Europe/Amsterdam"

  quiet_hours = {
    start = "22:00"
    end   = "07:00"
  }

  events = {
    # Formerly submit_action_failure_notification_enabled
    "product.SubmitActionFailed" = { in_app = true, email = true }

    # Formerly email_quota_warning_enabled
    "product.EmailQuotaWarning" = { in_app = true, email = true }

    # Formerly storage_warning_enabled
    "product.StorageWarning" = { in_app = true, email = false }

    # Keep new-submission notices in the inbox only
    "product.SubmissionReceived" = { email = false }
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `digest_hour_local` (Number) Hour of the day (0 to 23, in `time_zone_id`) at which the daily digest is sent.
- `email_enabled` (Boolean) Master email switch. When `false`, no notification is emailed regardless of the per-event `email` choices.
- `email_mode` (String) How email is delivered: `Immediate` or `DailyDigest`.
- `events` (Attributes Map) Per-event choices keyed by event key, for example `product.StorageWarning`. Only the listed events are managed. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--events))
- `quiet_hours` (Attributes) Daily window in which immediate email is held until it ends. Omit it for no quiet hours. The window may wrap midnight, for example `22:00` to `07:00`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--quiet_hours))
- `time_zone_id` (String) Time zone used for the digest hour and quiet hours, for example `Europe/Amsterdam`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedatt--events"></a>
### Nested Schema for `events`

Optional:

- `email` (Boolean) Whether the notification is also emailed. Requires `in_app` to be `true`. Omitted keeps the current server value, or `false` when `in_app` is `false`.
- `in_app` (Boolean) Whether the notification appears in the in-app inbox. Omitted keeps the current server value.


<a id="nestedatt--quiet_hours"></a>
### Nested Schema for `quiet_hours`

Required:

- `end` (String) End of the window, formatted `HH:mm`. Must differ from `start`.
- `start` (String) Start of the window, formatted `HH:mm`.
